title: TDengine MCP 连接配置
description: 连接您的 TDengine 平台。API Key 仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下。
description_en: Connect your TDengine platform. The API Key is stored only locally under ~/.workbuddy.
docLabel: 如何获取 TDengine IDMP API Key？
